Definition: Joseph, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joseph is the son of Jacob whose story carries Genesis to its close. In Genesis 30:24 Rachel names him at his birth, and Exodus 1:5 counts him among the souls who came into Egypt. Numbers 1:10 names his sons Ephraim and Manasseh as the tribes that carry his name forward, and from the coat to the pit to the palace, his life is the thread God uses to bring his family into Egypt and keep them alive.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joseph's life is the clearest picture in Genesis of God working through suffering. I hold that what his brothers meant for evil, God meant for good, and that the Joseph of Genesis 30:24, counted in Exodus 1:5 and carried on in Numbers 1:10, is proof that God keeps his people even in Egypt.
